summary: UTime Limited, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, disclosed via Form 6-K that it was served with legal proceedings in the High Court of Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Plaintiff Giant Credit Limited alleges UTime acted as guarantor of another defendant's loan obligations and seeks approximately HK$20.4 million in principal, interest and related amounts, plus costs and other relief. UTime states it is reviewing the claims with legal advisers, believes it has defenses, reserves all rights, and cannot reasonably estimate the outcome; this is litigation disclosure, not a special situation.
